// Optimized topics for short-form content with high engagement potential
const shortFormTopics = [
  "5 AI tools everyone uses wrong",
  "Why this celebrity scandal broke the internet",
  "The truth about remote work nobody tells you",
  "3 money mistakes destroying your future",
  "This social media trend is actually dangerous",
  "Why Bitcoin crashed (and what's next)",
  "The psychology trick that controls your mind",
  "5 productivity hacks that actually backfire",
  "Why everyone is quitting their job in 2024",
  "The dark side of influencer culture exposed",
  "3 investing secrets the rich don't want you to know",
  "Why your smartphone is making you depressed",
  "The food industry doesn't want you to know this",
  "5 career myths that keep you broke",
  "Why minimalism is actually toxic"
];

// Select random topic and determine content format
const randomTopic = shortFormTopics[Math.floor(Math.random() * shortFormTopics.length)];
const contentType = Math.random() < 0.7 ? 'short' : 'regular'; // 70% shorts, 30% regular
const targetDuration = contentType === 'short' ? 60 : 240; // 60s for shorts, 4min for regular

return {
  selectedTopic: randomTopic,
  contentType: contentType,
  targetDuration: targetDuration,
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  hashtags: '#trending #viral #facts #tips #lifehacks'
};
